product_metadata.title: SHACOS Round Braided Placemats Set of 6 Round Table Mats for Dining Tables 15 inch Washable Non Slip Placemats (Pink, 6)
features: Braided with Polyester clear thin threads and Cotton blend threads. Wrinkle resistant. Under light the clear wiring is a little shiny or glittery. 15 inch across, large enough for any plate or bowl.
Protect and dress up your tables. Fit rectangular, round and oval tables. Go well with almost any kitchen or dining room decoration.
Set of 6. Folded in half for easier transportation. Steam iron low heat if there is any fold line.
Easy to clean: Wipe clean with damp cloth. Hand wash and air dry.
Use Shacos round placemats for birthdays, Christmas, housewarming, holiday, parties, family gatherings, weddings, showers, and more. Great for everyday use inside or outside.
